Name: EVENT_FLAG_USAGE_PARAM_ST
Description: Event flag ranges and what they are used for. Loaded from the game's own files, not the regulation. Each row covers the flags from its row ID to ID + Flag Num − 1.

Fields.Name: Usage Type
Fields.Description: 0: the row's flag range is collected by the game's flag-usage pass. 1: the row is handled in a separate pass together with Play Log Category. What either pass does with the flags is not established. This param is loaded from its own files, not from regulation.bin.

Fields.Name: Play Log Category
Fields.Description: Read only for rows of Usage Type 1, where a non-zero value makes the game process the row further; what it selects is not established.

Fields.Name: Reserved Flag Count
Fields.Description: Number of event flags the row covers: from the row ID to row ID + this - 1.
